title: The for loop
summary: Its three parts, and counting from 1 to n.

steps.title: Three parts
steps.say: A `for` loop says where to start, when to keep going, and how to step.

marks.label: keep going while this is true
after each pass, add 1 to i

steps.title: Off by one
steps.say: The most common loop bug: `<` vs `<=`.

board.code:
for (int i = 1; i < n; i++)   // 1 .. n-1  (misses n)
for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)  // 1 .. n

steps.title: No while loops
steps.say: Team standard: use `for`, not `while`. A `while` loop that never ends freezes a robot. A `for` loop makes you write the ending up front.
